'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Steve Baroni LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Sheet name '''Baroni'''; deck '''I really did steal your meat flaps'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
